svg.title: Mansa Musa: Malian royal parasol
svg.desc: Period motif. A royal parasol topped with a bird, based on Ibn Battuta’s eyewitness description of the court of Mansa Sulayman, Musa’s later successor. It represents fourteenth-century Malian royal regalia, not a documented flag or a claim that this exact parasol belonged to Musa. Colors follow the game palette, with darker banner ink where needed for contrast; not historical flag colors.
